description: Experiment 2 (MAX_TOKENS truncation): conditions closely matching the historical max_tokens_safe_failure golden trace — an at-risk project with a concrete, unresolved bug reported only in a Slack thread and no corresponding Linear issue, which should prompt a mitigation proposal. approval_policy is 'reject' deliberately: this scenario verifies the model reaches a COMPLETE, valid proposal and the approval boundary is exercised, not that a write succeeds — zero mutation stays the safest default. See docs/evaluation.md 'Experiment 2' for the before/after measurement this scenario was built to support. Distinct from max_tokens_safe_failure (golden_trace, unchanged, still asserts the historical failure was handled safely) — this scenario asserts current runtime behavior avoids that failure, a different claim.
